chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya and Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sayqal, from his father, from Mansur, who said:

Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said to me: O Mansur, this matter will not come to you except after despair; and no, by Allah, not until you are distinguished; and no, by Allah, not until you are thoroughly tested; and no, by Allah, not until the one who is wretched becomes wretched and the one who is felicitous becomes felicitous.

key_terms.إِيَاسٍ: despair; loss of worldly expectation before relief arrives
key_terms.تُمَحَّصُوا: you are thoroughly tested and purified through trial
key_terms.تُمَيَّزُوا: you are distinguished; separated from one another and made distinct
key_terms.هَذَا الْأَمْرَ: this matter; the divinely significant affair being awaited
key_terms.يَسْعَدَ: becomes felicitous; attains blessedness and good outcome
key_terms.يَشْقَى: becomes wretched; attains misery in outcome

ai.seo_question: According to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام, what must happen before this matter comes to the believers?
ai.summary: Imam Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام tells Mansur that the fulfillment of this matter will only come after a period of despair and severe testing. The narration emphasizes differentiation and purification among people, until the fate of the wretched and the felicitous becomes manifest.
